Install and publish.

  1. 01
    Download the .tgz and keep it somewhere stable — your project's Packages/ folder is ideal.Unity references the file by path.
  2. 02
    Window › Package Manager › + › Add package from tarball… and pick it.The install finishes with no console errors.
  3. 03
    Open Tools › Verse › Publish Scene; optionally paste an account token from Studio.The window remembers it.
  4. 04
    Press Publish scene.Upload %, then the build stages, then the link — copied for you.

Go deeper.

The full guide covers export settings, materials, lighting and troubleshooting.

Publish from Unity→

WHAT GETS PUBLISHED

  • The open scene (or the selection) as one scene
  • Lighting baked on publish; the skybox as the background
  • Terrain as tile meshes, LOD0 of every LOD group
  • Textures at source resolution — nothing downscaled

Big projects.

Up to 20 GB, sent in resumable parts. Browser uploads stop at 500 MB.
